basics.name: Sajad Rahimi
basics.label: Senior PHP Full Stack Developer / Team Lead
basics.summary: Self-taught senior software developer experienced in building scalable web applications and leading engineering teams. Skilled in PHP (Laravel, Slim, Symfony), Node.js (Express, NestJS), TypeScript, and full-stack development. Designed high-performance search systems, integrated third-party services, and delivered web and mobile platforms. Committed to continuous learning, collaborative teamwork, and improving delivery through agile practices.

work.name: Iranicard (Paliz Group)
work.summary: Lead development of Pateh, a booking platform for flights, buses, hotels, tours, and insurance, and contribute to Iranicard international payment services.
highlights: Led a team of 8 developers to design and build more than 25 microservices for the Pateh booking platform.
Integrated more than 20 third-party flight and hotel booking APIs.
Built a system capable of handling over 10,000 flight search requests per second.
Designed a flight search engine that returned results in less than one second in 90% of cases, supporting growth during the first year.
Improved Iranicard international payment integrations, resolved security issues and bugs, optimized databases, and improved the customer experience.

work.name: Amreton
work.summary: Developed backend services and APIs for customer and driver applications on an internet taxi platform that expanded into food delivery, medical assistance, and logistics services.
highlights: Built client and driver APIs with PHP, Laravel, MySQL, Node.js, and Express.
Optimized travel allocation APIs and migrated communication to WebSocket technology.
Collaborated through Scrum sprints, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, sprint planning, and demos.

work.name: Talamala
work.summary: Independently developed the Talamala website, two Android applications for users and administrators, and the supporting backend.
highlights: Delivered an integrated website, user Android app, and administrator Android app.
Built a PHP and MySQL backend for data processing and communication across the platform.
Developed web interfaces using JavaScript, jQuery, and AJAX.

work.name: Ponisha
work.summary: Delivered customized websites and software solutions for freelance clients using WordPress, PHP, and JavaScript.
highlights: Developed responsive websites with dynamic functionality and user-friendly interfaces.
Built tailored solutions using PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and jQuery to meet client requirements.
